# Audio credits

All clips are short, loudness-normalised excerpts or recordings from public research datasets,
taken from patients in RespiNet's locked test split (never trained on):

- ICBHI 2017 Respiratory Sound Database (Rocha et al., 2019)
- KAUH lung sounds, Mendeley Data, doi:10.17632/jwyy9np4gv.3 (CC BY 4.0)
- Kaggle "Asthma Detection Dataset Version 2"

Per-clip source files, patient IDs and time ranges: `frontend/src/content/clips.provenance.json`.
